questions.stem: — ____ I come with you? — No, you needn't.

options.distractor: 答语是 needn't，问句也要用 need
need 不与 be 动词搭配
must 的否定回答才是 needn't，但答语要求问句一致

questions.explanation: need 作情态动词的疑问句：Need I come?

questions.stem: We ____ to water the flowers today. It rained last night.

options.distractor: 主语是 we，助动词用 do

questions.explanation: don't need to water（实义动词用法）。

questions.stem: She ____ any help. She can do it herself.

options.distractor: needn't 后面要接动词原形，这里接的是名词 help

questions.explanation: 后面接名词 help → 实义动词 doesn't need。

questions.stem: You ____ finish the work today if you are tired.

options.distractor: don't need 后面要加 to

options.text: You needn't get up so early on Sunday.
He doesn't need to go there today.
She needs not come to the meeting.
We need to buy some fruit.

questions.explanation: 应改为 She needn't come 或 She doesn't need to come。

questions.stem: — Must I return the book now? — No, you ____. You may ____ it for another week.

options.distractor: mustn't 是“禁止”，这里说“不必”
书已经在手上，不能再说 borrow
can't 是“不能”，与答语矛盾

questions.explanation: 不必 → needn't；再借一周 → keep。
